mapper.select: SELECT CONF_ID as "confId", INST_NM as "instNm", INST_CD as "instCd", SEND_SYS_CD as "sendSysCd", LINK_MTHD as "linkMthd", INST_META_USER_ID as "instMetaUserId", SFTP_HOST as "sftpHost", SFTP_PORT as "sftpPort", SFTP_USER_ID as "sftpUserId", CASE WHEN SFTP_PWD IS NULL OR SFTP_PWD = '' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END as "sftpPwdSetYn", SFTP_DIR as "sftpDir", TMP_FILE_DIR as "tmpFileDir", META_FILE_DIR as "metaFileDir", FILE_KEEP_CNT as "fileKeepCnt", FILE_FMT as "fileFmt", FILE_ENCODING as "fileEncoding", DFLT_BRM_ID as "dfltBrmId", UPDT_DT as "updtDt", UPDT_USER_ID as "updtUserId" FROM TB_GOV_META_CONF WHERE CONF_ID = 'DEFAULT'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_GOV_META_CONF (CONF_ID, INST_NM, INST_CD, SEND_SYS_CD, LINK_MTHD, INST_META_USER_ID, SFTP_HOST, SFTP_PORT, SFTP_USER_ID, SFTP_PWD, SFTP_DIR, TMP_FILE_DIR, META_FILE_DIR, FILE_KEEP_CNT, FILE_FMT, FILE_ENCODING, DFLT_BRM_ID, CRET_DT, CRET_USER_ID, UPDT_DT, UPDT_USER_ID) VALUES ('DEFAULT', #{instNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{instCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sendSysCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{linkMthd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{instMetaUserId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sftpHost, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sftpPort, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{sftpUserId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sftpPwd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sftpDir, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{tmpFileDir, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{metaFileDir, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{fileKeepCnt, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{fileFmt, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{fileEncoding, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dfltBrmId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, to_char(now(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), #{userId}, to_char(now(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), #{userId}) ON CONFLICT (CONF_ID) DO UPDATE SET INST_NM = EXCLUDED.INST_NM, INST_CD = EXCLUDED.INST_CD, SEND_SYS_CD = EXCLUDED.SEND_SYS_CD, LINK_MTHD = EXCLUDED.LINK_MTHD, INST_META_USER_ID = EXCLUDED.INST_META_USER_ID, SFTP_HOST = EXCLUDED.SFTP_HOST, SFTP_PORT = EXCLUDED.SFTP_PORT, SFTP_USER_ID = EXCLUDED.SFTP_USER_ID, SFTP_PWD = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.SFTP_PWD, TB_GOV_META_CONF.SFTP_PWD), SFTP_DIR = EXCLUDED.SFTP_DIR, TMP_FILE_DIR = EXCLUDED.TMP_FILE_DIR, META_FILE_DIR = EXCLUDED.META_FILE_DIR, FILE_KEEP_CNT = EXCLUDED.FILE_KEEP_CNT, FILE_FMT = EXCLUDED.FILE_FMT, FILE_ENCODING = EXCLUDED.FILE_ENCODING, DFLT_BRM_ID = EXCLUDED.DFLT_BRM_ID, UPDT_DT = EXCLUDED.UPDT_DT, UPDT_USER_ID = EXCLUDED.UPDT_USER_ID
mapper.select: SELECT BRM_ID as "brmId", BRM_NM as "brmNm", PARENT_BRM_ID as "parentBrmId", BRM_LVL as "brmLvl", BRM_PATH as "brmPath", INST_CD as "instCd", BRM_SRC as "brmSrc", USE_YN as "useYn", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_GOV_BRM C WHERE C.PARENT_BRM_ID = B.BRM_ID) as "childCnt" FROM TB_GOV_BRM B WHERE 1 = 1 AND B.BRM_SRC = #{brmSrc} AND (B.BRM_NM ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR B.BRM_PATH ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%') AND B.BRM_LVL <= #{maxLvl} ORDER BY COALESCE(B.BRM_PATH, B.BRM_NM), B.BRM_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_GOV_BRM (BRM_ID, BRM_NM, PARENT_BRM_ID, BRM_LVL, BRM_PATH, INST_CD, BRM_SRC, USE_YN, CRET_DT, CRET_USER_ID, UPDT_DT, UPDT_USER_ID) VALUES (#{brmId}, #{brmNm}, #{parentBrmId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{brmLvl, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{brmPath, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{instCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{brmSrc}, COALESCE(#{useYn, jdbcType=CHAR}, 'Y'), to_char(now(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), #{userId}, to_char(now(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), #{userId}) ON CONFLICT (BRM_ID) DO UPDATE SET BRM_NM = EXCLUDED.BRM_NM, PARENT_BRM_ID = EXCLUDED.PARENT_BRM_ID, BRM_LVL = EXCLUDED.BRM_LVL, BRM_PATH = EXCLUDED.BRM_PATH, INST_CD = EXCLUDED.INST_CD, BRM_SRC = EXCLUDED.BRM_SRC, USE_YN = EXCLUDED.USE_YN, UPDT_DT = EXCLUDED.UPDT_DT, UPDT_USER_ID = EXCLUDED.UPDT_USER_ID
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_GOV_BRM WHERE PARENT_BRM_ID = #{brmId}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_GOV_META_DB WHERE BRM_ID = #{brmId}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_GOV_META_CONF WHERE DFLT_BRM_ID = #{brmId})

SELECT CODE_GRP as "codeGrp", LOCAL_VAL as "localVal", GOV_CODE as "govCode", GOV_CODE_NM as "govCodeNm", SORT_ORDER as "sortOrder", USE_YN as "useYn", UPDT_DT as "updtDt", UPDT_USER_ID as "updtUserId" FROM TB_GOV_META_CODE_MAP WHERE 1 = 1 AND CODE_GRP = #{codeGrp} ORDER BY CODE_GRP, SORT_ORDER, LOCAL_VAL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_GOV_META_CODE_MAP (CODE_GRP, LOCAL_VAL, GOV_CODE, GOV_CODE_NM, SORT_ORDER, USE_YN, UPDT_DT, UPDT_USER_ID) VALUES (#{codeGrp}, #{localVal}, #{govCode}, #{govCodeNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, COALESCE(#{sortOrder, jdbcType=INTEGER}, 0), COALESCE(#{useYn, jdbcType=CHAR}, 'Y'), to_char(now(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), #{userId}) ON CONFLICT (CODE_GRP, LOCAL_VAL) DO UPDATE SET GOV_CODE = EXCLUDED.GOV_CODE, GOV_CODE_NM = EXCLUDED.GOV_CODE_NM, SORT_ORDER = EXCLUDED.SORT_ORDER, USE_YN = EXCLUDED.USE_YN, UPDT_DT = EXCLUDED.UPDT_DT, UPDT_USER_ID = EXCLUDED.UPDT_USER_ID
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_GOV_META_CODE_MAP WHERE CODE_GRP = #{codeGrp} AND LOCAL_VAL = #{localVal}
mapper.select: SELECT S.SYS_CD as "sysCd", S.P_SYS_CD as "pSysCd", S.SYS_TP as "sysTp", S.SYS_NM as "sysNm", array_to_string(S.SYS_DS_LST, ',') as "sysDsLst", G.GOV_SYS_NM as "govSysNm", G.GOV_SYS_CD as "govSysCd", G.GOV_SYS_TP as "govSysTp", G.STD_DSTB_TP as "stdDstbTp", G.OPER_DEPT_NM as "operDeptNm", G.CHRG_USER_NM as "chrgUserNm", G.CHRG_TELNO as "chrgTelno", G.CHRG_EMAIL as "chrgEmail", G.RLT_LAW_CN as "rltLawCn", G.BLD_YM as "bldYm", G.LAST_UPGRD_YM as "lastUpgrdYm", COALESCE(G.SEND_YN, 'N') as "sendYn", G.UPDT_DT as "updtDt", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_OBJ O JOIN TB_DATA_MODEL M ON M.DM_ID = O.DM_ID WHERE M.DM_SYS_CD = S.SYS_CD AND M.USE_YN = 'Y' AND COALESCE(M.APRV_STATUS, 'APPROVED') = 'APPROVED' AND O.USE_YN = 'Y' AND COALESCE(O.APRV_STATUS, 'APPROVED') = 'APPROVED') as "tblCnt", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_OBJ O JOIN TB_DATA_MODEL M ON M.DM_ID = O.DM_ID WHERE M.DM_SYS_CD = S.SYS_CD AND M.USE_YN = 'Y' AND COALESCE(M.APRV_STATUS, 'APPROVED') = 'APPROVED' AND O.USE_YN = 'Y' AND COALESCE(O.APRV_STATUS, 'APPROVED') = 'APPROVED' AND O.GOV_SEND_YN = 'Y') as "sendTblCnt" FROM TB_SYS_INFO S LEFT JOIN TB_GOV_META_SYS G ON G.SYS_CD = S.SYS_CD
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_GOV_META_SYS (SYS_CD, GOV_SYS_NM, GOV_SYS_CD, GOV_SYS_TP, STD_DSTB_TP, OPER_DEPT_NM, CHRG_USER_NM, CHRG_TELNO, CHRG_EMAIL, RLT_LAW_CN, BLD_YM, LAST_UPGRD_YM, SEND_YN, CRET_DT, CRET_USER_ID, UPDT_DT, UPDT_USER_ID) VALUES (#{sysCd}, #{govSysNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{govSysCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{govSysTp, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{stdDstbTp, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{operDeptNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{chrgUserNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{chrgTelno, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{chrgEmail, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{rltLawCn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{bldYm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{lastUpgrdYm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, COALESCE(#{sendYn, jdbcType=CHAR}, 'N'), to_char(now(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), #{userId}, to_char(now(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), #{userId}) ON CONFLICT (SYS_CD) DO UPDATE SET GOV_SYS_NM = EXCLUDED.GOV_SYS_NM, GOV_SYS_CD = EXCLUDED.GOV_SYS_CD, GOV_SYS_TP = EXCLUDED.GOV_SYS_TP, STD_DSTB_TP = EXCLUDED.STD_DSTB_TP, OPER_DEPT_NM = EXCLUDED.OPER_DEPT_NM, CHRG_USER_NM = EXCLUDED.CHRG_USER_NM, CHRG_TELNO = EXCLUDED.CHRG_TELNO, CHRG_EMAIL = EXCLUDED.CHRG_EMAIL, RLT_LAW_CN = EXCLUDED.RLT_LAW_CN, BLD_YM = EXCLUDED.BLD_YM, LAST_UPGRD_YM = EXCLUDED.LAST_UPGRD_YM, SEND_YN = EXCLUDED.SEND_YN, UPDT_DT = EXCLUDED.UPDT_DT, UPDT_USER_ID = EXCLUDED.UPDT_USER_ID
mapper.sql: DS.DS_ID as "dsId", DS.DSN as "dsn", DS.DBMS_TP as "dbmsTp", DS.DB_NAME as "dbName", G.REP_DM_ID as "repDmId", G.DB_NM_KR as "dbNmKr", G.DB_NM_EN as "dbNmEn", G.DB_DESC as "dbDesc", G.DB_FORM_CD as "dbFormCd", G.BRM_ID as "brmId", B.BRM_PATH as "brmPath", B.BRM_NM as "brmNm", G.DBMS_NM as "dbmsNm", G.DBMS_VER as "dbmsVer", G.OS_NM as "osNm", G.OS_VER as "osVer", G.DBMS_INFO_CLCT_DT as "dbmsInfoClctDt", G.UPDT_DT as "updtDt"
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TB_SYS_INFO S CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(S.SYS_DS_LST) AS X(DS_ID) JOIN ndata.tb_data_source DS ON DS.DS_ID = X.DS_ID LEFT JOIN TB_GOV_META_DB G ON G.DS_ID = DS.DS_ID LEFT JOIN TB_GOV_BRM B ON B.BRM_ID = G.BRM_ID WHERE S.SYS_CD = #{sysCd} ORDER BY DS.DSN
SELECT FROM ndata.tb_data_source DS LEFT JOIN TB_GOV_META_DB G ON G.DS_ID = DS.DS_ID LEFT JOIN TB_GOV_BRM B ON B.BRM_ID = G.BRM_ID WHERE DS.DS_ID = #{dsId}

SELECT M.DM_ID as "dmId", M.DM_NM as "dmNm", M.DM_DS_ID as "dsId", M.DM_SYS_CD as "sysCd" FROM TB_DATA_MODEL M WHERE M.USE_YN = 'Y' AND COALESCE(M.APRV_STATUS, 'APPROVED') = 'APPROVED' AND M.DM_DS_ID IN #{d} ORDER BY M.DM_NM
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_GOV_META_DB (DS_ID, REP_DM_ID, DB_NM_KR, DB_NM_EN, DB_DESC, DB_FORM_CD, BRM_ID, OS_NM, OS_VER, CRET_DT, CRET_USER_ID, UPDT_DT, UPDT_USER_ID) VALUES (#{dsId}, #{repDmId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dbNmKr, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dbNmEn, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dbDesc, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dbFormCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{brmId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{osNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{osVer, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, to_char(now(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), #{userId}, to_char(now(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), #{userId}) ON CONFLICT (DS_ID) DO UPDATE SET REP_DM_ID = EXCLUDED.REP_DM_ID, DB_NM_KR = EXCLUDED.DB_NM_KR, DB_NM_EN = EXCLUDED.DB_NM_EN, DB_DESC = EXCLUDED.DB_DESC, DB_FORM_CD = EXCLUDED.DB_FORM_CD, BRM_ID = EXCLUDED.BRM_ID, OS_NM = EXCLUDED.OS_NM, OS_VER = EXCLUDED.OS_VER, UPDT_DT = EXCLUDED.UPDT_DT, UPDT_USER_ID = EXCLUDED.UPDT_USER_ID

INSERT INTO TB_GOV_META_DB (DS_ID, DBMS_NM, DBMS_VER, DBMS_INFO_CLCT_DT, CRET_DT, CRET_USER_ID) VALUES (#{dsId}, #{dbmsNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dbmsVer, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, to_char(now(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), to_char(now(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), #{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) ON CONFLICT (DS_ID) DO UPDATE SET DBMS_NM = EXCLUDED.DBMS_NM, DBMS_VER = EXCLUDED.DBMS_VER, DBMS_INFO_CLCT_DT = EXCLUDED.DBMS_INFO_CLCT_DT
mapper.update:
UPDATE TB_DATA_MODEL_OBJ
GOV_SEND_YN = #{govSendYn}, TBL_TP = NULLIF(#{tblTp}, ''), OCCR_CYCLE = NULLIF(#{occrCycle}, ''), OPEN_TP = NULLIF(#{openTp}, ''), OPEN_LIMIT_REASON = NULLIF(#{openLimitReason}, ''), OPEN_LIMIT_BASIS = NULLIF(#{openLimitBasis}, ''), OPEN_DATA_LST_NM = NULLIF(#{openDataLstNm}, ''),
WHERE (DM_ID, OBJ_OWNER, OBJ_NM) IN (#{k.dmId}, #{k.objOwner}, #{k.objNm})
mapper.select: SELECT PC.*, A.DBMS_DATA_TYPE as "dbmsDataType", A.NULLABLE_YN as "nullableYn", A.PK_YN as "pkYn", A.FK_YN as "fkYn", A.DEFAULT_VAL as "defaultVal", A.ATTR_COMMENT as "attrComment", A.OPEN_TP as "openTp", A.OPEN_LIMIT_REASON as "openLimitReason", A.CNSTR_DESC as "cnstrDesc", (SELECT MIN(C.COLUMN_POS) FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_CONSTRAINT C WHERE C.DM_ID = A.DM_ID AND C.OBJ_OWNER = A.OBJ_OWNER AND C.TABLE_NM = A.OBJ_NM AND C.COLUMN_NM = A.ATTR_NM AND C.CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'P' AND COALESCE(C.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y') as "pkPos", COALESCE((SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT C.REF_TABLE_NM || '.' || C.REF_COLUMN_NM, ', ') FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_CONSTRAINT C WHERE C.DM_ID = A.DM_ID AND C.OBJ_OWNER = A.OBJ_OWNER AND C.TABLE_NM = A.OBJ_NM AND C.COLUMN_NM = A.ATTR_NM AND C.CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'R' AND COALESCE(C.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' AND C.REF_TABLE_NM IS NOT NULL), CASE WHEN A.FK_PARENT_OBJ_NM IS NOT NULL THEN A.FK_PARENT_OBJ_NM || '.' || COALESCE(A.FK_PARENT_ATTR_NM, A.ATTR_NM) END) as "fkRef", (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT C.SEARCH_CONDITION, ' / ') FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_CONSTRAINT C WHERE C.DM_ID = A.DM_ID AND C.OBJ_OWNER = A.OBJ_OWNER AND C.TABLE_NM = A.OBJ_NM AND C.COLUMN_NM = A.ATTR_NM AND C.CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'C' AND COALESCE(C.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' AND C.SEARCH_CONDITION IS NOT NULL AND C.SEARCH_CONDITION NOT ILIKE '%IS NOT NULL') as "chkCond" FROM ( AND A.DM_ID = #{dmId} AND A.OBJ_OWNER = #{objOwner} AND A.OBJ_NM = #{objNm} ) PC JOIN TB_DATA_MODEL_ATTR A ON A.DM_ID = PC."dmId" AND A.OBJ_OWNER = PC."objOwner" AND A.OBJ_NM = PC."objNm" AND A.ATTR_NM = PC."attrNm" ORDER BY PC."objOwner", PC."objNm", PC."attrOrd", PC."attrNm"
mapper.update:
UPDATE TB_DATA_MODEL_ATTR
OPEN_TP = NULLIF(#{openTp}, ''), OPEN_LIMIT_REASON = NULLIF(#{openLimitReason}, ''), CNSTR_DESC = NULLIF(#{cnstrDesc}, ''),
WHERE (DM_ID, OBJ_OWNER, OBJ_NM, ATTR_NM) IN (#{k.dmId}, #{k.objOwner}, #{k.objNm}, #{k.attrNm})
mapper.select:
WITH RECURSIVE SYS (SYS_CD, DEPTH) AS ( SELECT SYS_CD, 0 FROM TB_SYS_INFO WHERE SYS_CD = #{sysCd} UNION ALL SELECT C.SYS_CD, SYS.DEPTH + 1 FROM TB_SYS_INFO C JOIN SYS ON C.P_SYS_CD = SYS.SYS_CD WHERE SYS.DEPTH < 20 )
SELECT S.SYS_CD as "sysCd", S.SYS_NM as "sysNm", S.SYS_TP as "sysTp", array_to_string(S.SYS_DS_LST, ',') as "sysDsLst", G.GOV_SYS_NM as "govSysNm", G.GOV_SYS_CD as "govSysCd", G.GOV_SYS_TP as "govSysTp", G.OPER_DEPT_NM as "operDeptNm", COALESCE(G.SEND_YN, 'N') as "sendYn" FROM TB_SYS_INFO S LEFT JOIN TB_GOV_META_SYS G ON G.SYS_CD = S.SYS_CD WHERE 1 = 1 AND S.SYS_CD IN (SELECT SYS_CD FROM SYS) AND S.SYS_CD = #{sysCdExact} ORDER BY S.SYS_NM
SELECT DM_ID as "dmId", DM_NM as "dmNm", DM_SYS_CD as "sysCd", DM_DS_ID as "dsId", MODEL_TYPE as "modelType" FROM TB_DATA_MODEL WHERE DM_ID = #{dmId}

SELECT O.DM_ID as "dmId", O.OBJ_OWNER as "objOwner", O.OBJ_NM as "objNm", O.OBJ_NM_KR as "objNmKr", O.TBL_TP as "tblTp", O.OCCR_CYCLE as "occrCycle", O.OPEN_TP as "openTp", O.OPEN_LIMIT_REASON as "openLimitReason", O.OPEN_LIMIT_BASIS as "openLimitBasis" FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_OBJ O WHERE O.DM_ID = #{dmId} AND O.USE_YN = 'Y' AND COALESCE(O.APRV_STATUS, 'APPROVED') = 'APPROVED' AND O.GOV_SEND_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY O.OBJ_OWNER, O.OBJ_NM

SELECT PC."objOwner", PC."objNm", PC."attrNm", PC."attrNmKr", PC."privYn", PC."encrYn", A.OPEN_TP as "openTp", A.OPEN_LIMIT_REASON as "openLimitReason", A.FK_PARENT_OBJ_NM as "fkParentObjNm", A.FK_PARENT_OBJ_OWNER as "fkParentObjOwner", (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT COALESCE(C.REF_OWNER, '') || '|' || C.REF_TABLE_NM, ',') FROM TB_DATA_MODEL_CONSTRAINT C WHERE C.DM_ID = A.DM_ID AND C.OBJ_OWNER = A.OBJ_OWNER AND C.TABLE_NM = A.OBJ_NM AND C.COLUMN_NM = A.ATTR_NM AND C.CONSTRAINT_TYPE = 'R' AND COALESCE(C.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' AND C.REF_TABLE_NM IS NOT NULL) as "fkRefTbls" FROM ( AND A.DM_ID = #{dmId}) PC JOIN TB_DATA_MODEL_ATTR A ON A.DM_ID = PC."dmId" AND A.OBJ_OWNER = PC."objOwner" AND A.OBJ_NM = PC."objNm" AND A.ATTR_NM = PC."attrNm" JOIN TB_DATA_MODEL_OBJ O ON O.DM_ID = A.DM_ID AND O.OBJ_OWNER = A.OBJ_OWNER AND O.OBJ_NM = A.OBJ_NM AND O.GOV_SEND_YN = 'Y' AND O.USE_YN = 'Y' AND COALESCE(O.APRV_STATUS, 'APPROVED') = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY PC."objOwner", PC."objNm", PC."attrOrd"
SELECT CODE_GRP as "codeGrp", LOCAL_VAL as "localVal", GOV_CODE as "govCode" FROM TB_GOV_META_CODE_MAP WHERE USE_YN = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_GOV_META_SEND (SEND_ID, DM_ID, SYS_CD, DS_ID, TRIGGER_TYPE, SCHEDULE_LOG_ID, STATUS, START_DT, LINK_MTHD, CRET_USER_ID) VALUES (#{sendId}, #{dmId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sysCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{dsId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{triggerType}, #{scheduleLogId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{status}, to_char(now(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS'), #{linkMthd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR})

INSERT INTO TB_GOV_META_SEND_ERR (SEND_ID, ERR_SEQ, ERR_LVL, SEV, SYS_CD, DS_ID, OBJ_OWNER, OBJ_NM, ATTR_NM, ITEM_NM, ERR_MSG) VALUES
(#{sendId}, #{e.errSeq}, #{e.errLvl}, #{e.sev}, #{e.sysCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{e.dsId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{e.objOwner, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{e.objNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{e.attrNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{e.itemNm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{e.errMsg})
mapper.select: SELECT G.SEND_ID as "sendId", G.DM_ID as "dmId", M.DM_NM as "dmNm", G.SYS_CD as "sysCd", S.SYS_NM as "sysNm", G.DS_ID as "dsId", G.TRIGGER_TYPE as "triggerType", G.SCHEDULE_LOG_ID as "scheduleLogId", G.STATUS as "status", G.START_DT as "startDt", G.END_DT as "endDt", G.SYS_CNT as "sysCnt", G.DB_CNT as "dbCnt", G.TBL_CNT as "tblCnt", G.COL_CNT as "colCnt", G.ERR_CNT as "errCnt", G.WARN_CNT as "warnCnt", G.FILE_NM as "fileNm", G.LINK_MTHD as "linkMthd", G.SEND_STATUS as "sendStatus", G.SEND_MSG as "sendMsg", G.CRET_USER_ID as "cretUserId" FROM TB_GOV_META_SEND G LEFT JOIN TB_DATA_MODEL M ON M.DM_ID = G.DM_ID LEFT JOIN TB_SYS_INFO S ON S.SYS_CD = G.SYS_CD WHERE 1 = 1 AND G.SEND_ID = #{sendId} ORDER BY G.START_DT DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT E.ERR_SEQ as "errSeq", E.ERR_LVL as "errLvl", E.SEV as "sev", E.SYS_CD as "sysCd", S.SYS_NM as "sysNm", E.DS_ID as "dsId", DS.DSN as "dsn", E.OBJ_OWNER as "objOwner", E.OBJ_NM as "objNm", E.ATTR_NM as "attrNm", E.ITEM_NM as "itemNm", E.ERR_MSG as "errMsg", G.DM_ID as "dmId" FROM TB_GOV_META_SEND_ERR E JOIN TB_GOV_META_SEND G ON G.SEND_ID = E.SEND_ID LEFT JOIN TB_SYS_INFO S ON S.SYS_CD = E.SYS_CD LEFT JOIN ndata.tb_data_source DS ON DS.DS_ID = E.DS_ID WHERE E.SEND_ID = #{sendId} ORDER BY E.ERR_SEQ
